quizTitle: What’s It Worth? The Strange World of Value

questions.question: A slice of pizza once sold for $1,000 because it had edible gold flakes and caviar on it.
questions.answer: True - It was sold in New York as a luxury ‘gourmet pizza’ covered in gold, truffles, and lobster.

questions.question: Which item once sold for more money than a brand-new Ferrari?
options: A sandwich signed by a celebrity
questions.answer: A digital cat picture - The NFT ‘CryptoKitty’ once sold for over $170,000.

questions.question: What makes something valuable: rarity, usefulness, or what people are willing to pay?
questions.answer: All of the above - Value depends on culture, context, and emotion as much as on logic.

questions.question: Which of these items has actually been sold on eBay?
options: A grilled cheese with Jesus’s face
questions.answer: All of the above - People have paid thousands for strange, sentimental, or silly listings.

questions.question: A half-eaten toast once sold for $25,000 because it had the image of which celebrity?
questions.answer: Britney Spears - A fan sold her leftover breakfast online during her early fame years.

questions.question: The world’s most expensive painting, ‘Salvator Mundi’, was sold for how much?
questions.answer: $450 million - The Leonardo da Vinci painting was bought in 2017 by a Saudi prince.

questions.question: What did a man once trade for a single paperclip, after a series of clever exchanges?
questions.answer: A house - Kyle MacDonald famously traded up from a red paperclip to a house in 14 swaps.

questions.question: Why do people pay thousands for virtual land in the ‘metaverse’?
options: Because they hope to resell it
questions.answer: All of the above - Digital real estate became a speculative market like real-world property.

questions.question: A pair of sneakers worn by Michael Jordan sold for how much at auction?
questions.answer: $2.2 million - Sports memorabilia can become priceless for fans and collectors.

questions.question: Which of these things is probably the most valuable in the long run?
options: A limited-edition NFT of a potato
questions.answer: Time - You can’t buy more of it, no matter how rich you are.
